rationale: The plan correctly reads the question as a per-sample score problem and puts GSVA on the blind VST matrix (Gaussian kernel, log-scale input) with a limma moderated t-test, BH at 0.05, over MSigDB Hallmark, with a row-scaled condition-annotated heatmap and an explicit keep-inspect-report policy for sample_01. QC, filtering, in-model normalization, explicit ~condition with control reference, apeglm shrinkage and the reproducibility record are all stated concretely for this 6 vs 6 single-batch design. The DESeq2 Wald fit and fgsea cross-check are additional to what the question needs, but they are framed as supporting the universe and as a confirmatory ranked test rather than displacing the per-sample deliverable, so they cost little. The only soft spot is that the hallmark collection version is promised to be reported rather than named in the plan itself.
